title: Expected growth can hide extinction
hook: Two stated cases: explore the per-capita rates in a mean population model.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the per-capita rates in a mean population model affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Mean, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the per-capita rates in a mean population model in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Expected population follows a growth equation, while individual paths can go extinct. A growing mean is not a survival guarantee. This comparison isolates the per-capita rates in a mean population model.
